mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% for three months signals a strengthening labor market, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 4.0% but 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above their 12-month averages signals robust demand, leading to positive equity valuation adjustments and S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or one proxy rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three months triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates reducing growth expectations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceed 4.5% but 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the tightening is reversed before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% over three months indicates a strong labor market, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 5.0% but 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in production (INDPRO) exceeding 102.0 for the first time in three months signals robust economic activity, boosting market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 102.0 but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the surge is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (GDPC1) and demand from the manufacturing sector (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages indicates robust demand, driving equity price increases and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceed thresholds but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or one proxy rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate sustained job growth and economic momentum over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4.5% but returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or the decline is not sustained.
